summary.text: John Crawford is a Republican state representative from Bristol and Kingsport representing Tennessee House District 1 (part of Sullivan County), a member of the 110th through 114th General Assemblies. He chairs the House State & Local Government Committee.

paragraphs.text: Crawford was born on November 29, 1967, and owns Plaques Etc. and is chief financial officer of Able Printers.
He studied business and psychology at East Tennessee State University and is married to LeAnn.
He served on the Sullivan County Commission from 2002 to 2006 and from 2010 to 2016, and was an 18-year reserve police officer and past captain of the Kingsport Police Department reserve program.
His page also lists service as past president of the Kiwanis Club, past Kiwanis Lieutenant Governor of the KY-TN District and board member of the Bloomingdale Volunteer Fire Department.
